verses.greek: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε.
verses.literal: These things I have spoken to you that not you may fall away.
verses.dgt: “I have spoken these things to you so that you may not fall away.

verses.greek: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς· ἀλλʼ ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ θεῷ.
verses.literal: Out of the synagogues they will put you but is coming an hour that everyone who having killed you may think it is a service to offer the to God.
verses.dgt: They will put you out of the synagogues. In fact, an hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think he is offering service to God.

verses.greek: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ.
verses.literal: And these things they will do because not they know the Father nor Me myself.
verses.dgt: And they will do these things because they did not know the Father or me.

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε ⸁αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν. Ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον, ὅτι μεθʼ ὑμῶν ἤμην.
verses.literal: But these things I have said to you so that when may have come the hour of them you may remember those things that I myself said to you. These things now to you from the beginning not I said because with you I was.
verses.dgt: But I have spoken these things to you so that when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I did not tell you these things from the beginning because I was with you.

verses.greek: νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με· Ποῦ ὑπάγεις;
verses.literal: Now however I go to the One having sent Me and none of you asks Me Where are You going?
verses.dgt: But now I am going to the one who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν.
verses.literal: But because these things I have said to you the sorrow has filled your the heart.
verses.dgt: Instead, because I have spoken these things to you, sorrow has filled your heart.

verses.greek: ἀλλʼ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν, συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω. ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω, ὁ παράκλητος οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς· ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ, πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
verses.literal: But I myself the truth say to you it is profitable for you that I myself may go away only for unless I shall go away the Helper not not may come to you if however I shall go I will send Him to you.
verses.dgt: But I tell you the truth: it is better for you that I go away. For if I do not go away, the Advocate will certainly not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως·
verses.literal: And having come He will convict the world concerning sin and concerning righteousness and concerning judgment.
verses.dgt: And when he comes, he will convict the world concerning sin and concerning righteousness and concerning judgment:

verses.greek: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν, ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ·
verses.literal: concerning sin indeed because not do they believe in Me myself
verses.dgt: concerning sin, because they do not believe in me;

verses.greek: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ, ὅτι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με·
verses.literal: concerning righteousness however because to the Father I go away and no longer you behold Me
verses.dgt: concerning righteousness, because I am going to the Father and you see me no longer;

verses.greek: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως, ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται.
verses.literal: concerning now judgment because the ruler of the world this has been judged.
verses.dgt: and concerning judgment, because the ruler of this world has been judged.

verses.greek: Ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ὑμῖν λέγειν, ἀλλʼ οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι·
verses.literal: Yet many things I have to you to say but not you are able to bear them now.
verses.dgt: I still have many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.

verses.greek: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας, ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πάσῃ, οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφʼ ἑαυτοῦ, ἀλλʼ ὅσα ἀκούσει λαλήσει, καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: When however may come He the Spirit the of truth He will guide you into the truth all. not for He will speak from Himself but as much as He will hear He will speak and the things coming He will declare to you.
verses.dgt: But when he comes, the Spirit of truth, he will guide you in all the truth, for he will not speak from himself, but whatever he hears he will speak, and he will announce to you the things that are coming.

verses.greek: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει, ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: He Me myself will glorify for from that which is Mine He will take and will disclose to you.
verses.dgt: He will glorify me, because he will take from what is mine and announce it to you.

verses.greek: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν· διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: All things as much as has the Father Mine are because of this I said that from that which is Mine He receives and will disclose to you.
verses.dgt: Everything the Father has is mine. For this reason I said that he takes from what is mine and will announce it to you.

verses.greek: Μικρὸν καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με.
verses.literal: A little while and no longer you do behold Me and again a little while and you will behold Me
verses.dgt: A little while, and you no longer see me; and again a little while, and you will see me.”

verses.greek: εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με; καί· Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πατέρα;
verses.literal: Said therefore some of the disciples of him to one another What is this that He says to us A little while and not you do behold Me and again a little while and you will behold Me’? and Because I am going to the Father’?
verses.dgt: So some of his disciples said to one another, “What is this that he says to us: ‘A little while and you do not see me, and again a little while and you will see me,’ and, ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”

verses.greek: ἔλεγον οὖν· Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει μικρόν; οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ.
verses.literal: They were saying therefore what is This that He says a little while’? Not we do know what He is saying.
verses.dgt: So they were saying, “What is this ‘little while’ that he speaks of? We do not know what he is saying.”

verses.greek: ἔγνω Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετʼ ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον· Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με, καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με;
verses.literal: Knew Jesus that they were desiring Him to ask and He said to them Concerning this do you inquire among one another that I said A little while and not you do behold Me and again a little while and you will behold Me’?
verses.dgt: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Are you discussing with one another about this, because I said, ‘A little while and you do not see me, and again a little while and you will see me’?

verses.greek: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς, ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται· ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε, ἀλλʼ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται.
verses.literal: Amen Amen I say to you that you will weep and will lament you yourselves the but the world will rejoice You yourselves will be grieved but the grief of you to joy will turn.
verses.dgt: Truly, truly, I say to you: you will weep and mourn, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will become joy.

verses.greek: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει, ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς· ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον, οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον.
verses.literal: The woman when she may be giving birth pain has because has come the hour of her when however she may bring forth the child no longer she remembers the tribulation on account of the joy that has been born a man into the world.
verses.dgt: When a woman gives birth, she has sorrow because her hour has come; but when she has given birth to the child, she no longer remembers the distress because of the joy that a human being has been born into the world.

verses.greek: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν λύπην ἔχετε· πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς, καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία, καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφʼ ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: Also you yourselves therefore now indeed grief have again however I will see you and will rejoice your the heart and the joy of you no one do take from you
verses.dgt: So you also have sorrow now; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.

verses.greek: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν· ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν, ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν πατέρα δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου.
verses.literal: And in that very the day of Me myself not you will ask no thing. Amen Amen I say to you maybe whatever you may ask the Father He will give to you. in the name of Me
verses.dgt: And in that day you will ask me nothing. Truly, truly, I say to you: whatever you ask the Father, he will give you in my name.

verses.greek: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου· αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη.
verses.literal: Until now not you have asked no thing in the name of Me do ask and you will receive that the joy of you may be filled.
verses.dgt: Until now you have asked nothing in my name. Ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be made full.

verses.greek: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν· ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν.
verses.literal: These things in allegories I have spoken to you is coming an hour when no longer in allegories I will speak to you but plainly concerning the Father I will announce to you.
verses.dgt: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. An hour is coming when I will no longer speak to you in figures, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

verses.greek: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε, καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν·
verses.literal: In that very the day in the name of Me you will ask and not I say to you that I myself will implore the Father for you
verses.dgt: In that day you will ask in my name, and I do not tell you that I will ask the Father concerning you,

verses.greek: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς, ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον.
verses.literal: Himself for the Father loves you because you yourselves Me myself have loved and have believed that I myself from the God came forth.
verses.dgt: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.

verses.greek: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον· πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα.
verses.literal: I came forth from the Father and have come into the world again I leave the world and go to the Father.
verses.dgt: I came out from the Father and have come into the world; again I am leaving the world and going to the Father.”

verses.greek: Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ· Ἴδε νῦν ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς, καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις.
verses.literal: Say the disciples of Him Behold now in openness You speak and allegory no thing speak.
verses.dgt: His disciples say, “Look, now you are speaking plainly and are not saying any figure of speech.

verses.greek: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ· ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες.
verses.literal: Now we know that You know all things and not need have that anyone You may ask. In this we believe that from God You came forth.
verses.dgt: Now we know that you know all things and have no need that anyone question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

verses.greek: ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς· Ἄρτι πιστεύετε;
verses.literal: Answered to them Jesus Now do you believe?
verses.dgt: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

verses.greek: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε· καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος, ὅτι ὁ πατὴρ μετʼ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν.
verses.literal: Behold is coming an hour and has come when you may be scattered each to the his own and I alone you may leave yet not I am alone for the Father with Me is.
verses.dgt: Look, an hour is coming, and has come, when you will be scattered, each to his own, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

verses.greek: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε· ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε, ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε, ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον.
verses.literal: These things I have spoken to you so that in Me myself peace you may have. In the world tribulation you have But take courage! I myself have overcome the world.
verses.dgt: I have spoken these things to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have affliction. But take courage; I have overcome the world.”
